# better-react-hook-form/usefieldarray-require-field-id-key

📝 Require the generated field-array identifier as each row's key.

💼 This rule is enabled in the following configs: 🌐 `all`, ✅ `recommended`, 🔒 `strict`.

<!-- end auto-generated rule header -->

Use the stable identifier generated by useFieldArray for each directly mapped row, including its configured v7 keyName.

## Rule details

Incorrect:

```tsx
const { fields } = useFieldArray({ name: "users" });
const rows = fields.map((field, index) => <input key={index} />);
```

Correct:

```tsx
const { fields } = useFieldArray({ name: "users", keyName: "rowKey" });
const rows = fields.map(({ rowKey }) => <input key={rowKey} />);
```

The examples assume the corresponding hooks/components are imported from `react-hook-form` and React hooks from `react`.

## Limitations and fixes

Checks direct map callbacks, returned JSX elements/fragments, missing or proven undefined keys, member key reads, and destructured callback parameters. Unknown keyName values or spread-provided keys are skipped. Tracking stops after mutations through local member/destructuring aliases. Chained transformations and custom row render helpers are not inferred. The default is field.id in v7; v8 field.key is not supported. No automatic fix changes component identity.

All analysis is local to a file and resolves lexical bindings. Uncertain relationships are skipped. No type information is required.
